description.en: The agent ID. It must be a 3- to 10-digit number.

description.zh: 座席绑定电话；固话带区号，手机不加0；固话带分机的以'-'分隔
description.en: The phone number to delete from the agent. Include the area code for landline numbers. Do not prefix mobile phone numbers with 0. Use a hyphen (-) to separate a landline number from its extension number.
